faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for FDDI Junior Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the FDDI Junior Faculty positions is 27th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for Junior Faculty posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master Degree or PG Diploma in relevant Design fields with 55% marks, or a Bachelor Degree/Diploma in relevant Design fields with 55% marks. Specific qualifications vary by specialization.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Junior Faculty posts is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Faculty role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Junior Faculty position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the FDDI Junior Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline. Download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it via post to the address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this FDDI recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for FDDI Junior Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Faculty positions will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Junior Faculty positions at FDDI is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Footwear Design & Development Institute located?
faq.answer: The Footwear Design & Development Institute (FDDI) is located in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 201301.

faq.question: Q10. Are there any specific work experience requirements for the Junior Faculty (Leather Garments) post?
faq.answer: Yes, for the Junior Faculty (Leather Garments) post, a minimum of 1 year of experience in Leather Garments Pattern Making & Construction is required.
